features: 360° PAN & TILT VIEW: The CP PLUS 4MP Wi-Fi CCTV camera offers full 360° horizontal and 85° vertical rotation, giving you a complete panoramic view for indoor monitoring. Ideal for homes and shops, this smart camera eliminates blind spots with its smooth pan-tilt functionality.

IR Night Vision up to 15m – Infrared LEDs capture clear black-and-white video even in complete darkness, ensuring your Wi-Fi camera for home is effective 24x7.

Private Mode for Complete Peace of Mind – Instantly enable privacy mode through the app to pause live monitoring and recording. A key feature in any wifi camera for home or indoor cctv camera for added personal control.
Works with Google Home – Operate your CP PLUS Wi-Fi camera via voice commands, making it a smart home CCTV camera for effortless viewing.
